selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who is the first group in this passage?
questions.answer: They are the happy and righteous people who listened to the Prophet and followed the Qur’an.

questions.question: What two roles does the Master have in this passage?
questions.answer: He is a servant who worships Allah, and he is a messenger who delivers Allah’s message.

questions.question: How does he deliver Allah’s commands to people and jinn?
questions.answer: He delivers them through the Qur’an.

questions.question: What did this blessed community do when they heard the Messenger?
questions.answer: They paid attention, obeyed, and listened to the Qur’an.

questions.question: What important act of worship did they see placed on them?
questions.answer: They saw that the daily prayers were required for them.

questions.question: Why are the prayers described as very important in the passage?
questions.answer: Because they gather many kinds of worship and many duties into one worship.

questions.question: What response came from them when they sensed Allah’s mercy in His blessings?
questions.answer: They thanked Him, praised Him, and recognized His kindness.

questions.question: What feeling came after they noticed the beauty and fine art in created things?
questions.answer: Love and longing for Allah came into their hearts.

questions.question: What makes the first group different from others in the passage?
questions.answer: They accepted the Messenger’s guidance and followed the Qur’an.

questions.question: In the passage, how is the Master’s worship role different from his messenger role?
questions.answer: In worship, he represents his community before Allah, and in messengership, he brings Allah’s commands to creation.

questions.question: Which two groups receive the message through the Qur’an here?
questions.answer: Human beings and jinn.

questions.question: What did the believers understand about the prescribed prayers?
questions.answer: They understood that prayer points to many worship duties and high spiritual meanings.

questions.question: What was their response after seeing the amazing things Allah made?
questions.answer: They glorified Allah and announced His greatness.

questions.question: What did they do after recognizing Allah’s mercy in His gifts and blessings?
questions.answer: They thanked Him and praised Him.

questions.question: What did they do after understanding the blessings in Allah’s mercy?
questions.answer: They offered thanks and praise.

questions.question: What kind of people are described as the first group?
questions.answer: They are successful, good believers who followed the Prophet’s teaching.

questions.question: Why is the Master called the possessor of two wings in this passage?
questions.answer: Because he has two great duties: worshiping Allah and delivering Allah’s message.

questions.question: What book did the happy community listen to along with the Messenger?
questions.answer: They listened to the Qur’an.

questions.question: What did they discover about salah?
questions.answer: They discovered that salah contains many kinds of worship and points to many spiritual responsibilities.

questions.question: What was their first response when they observed Allah’s works?
questions.answer: They glorified Allah and proclaimed His greatness.

questions.question: When they understood the blessings coming from divine mercy, what duty did they carry out?
questions.answer: They carried out the duty of thankfulness and praise.

questions.question: What did they do when they saw beauty and fine design in creation?
questions.answer: They loved Allah more and longed for Him.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of community was the first group?
questions.answer: It was a blessed and joyful community of believers.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Messenger does for people and jinn?
questions.answer: He brings them Allah’s commands through the Qur’an.

title: Transition to Reality Believers Listening to the Messenger and Entering High Stations Through Prayer
